title: guapira broadwayana
intro: Guapira broadwayana, commonly known as the Guapira tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Nyctaginaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and inflammation due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Guapira broadwayana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, analgesic, and antispasmodic activities. The bioactive constituents present in Guapira broadwayana have been reported to possess antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic potential.
